senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. צַח) [to be bright, pure,] (cmp. זָכָה) to be victorious, win, prevail. Y. Sabb. VII, 5ᵇ top אם לִנְצוֹחַ אם להִינָּצֵחַ whether to conquer or to be conquered.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 119a:3">Pes. 119ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>לַמְנַצֵּחַ</he>) <he>זמרו למי שנוֹצְחִין אותו ושמח</he> sing to him who rejoices when they conquer him (prevail over him to change his evil decrees); <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV. Pesik. R. s. 40</cite> <he>נָצַחְתִּי לדור וכ׳</he> I conquered the generation of the flood and was the loser by it, because I destroyed &c.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:4">Ib.</cite> <he>נְצָחַנִי משה וכ׳</he> Moses conquered me …, and I gained all those masses; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N01101"><he>נָצוּחַ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Pesik. R. s. 40</cite> <he>נָצַחְתִּי לדור וכ׳</he> I conquered the generation of the flood and was the loser by it, because I destroyed &c.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Ib.</cite> <he>נְצָחַנִי משה וכ׳</he> Moses conquered me …, and I gained all those masses; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N01101"><he>נָצוּחַ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Ib.</cite> <he>בשעה שאני נוצח … ובשעה שאני נ׳ וכ׳</he> when I prevail, I lose, but when I am prevailed over, I gain; a. e.

senses.gloss: to make illustrious, to glorify. Midr. Till. l. c. (expl. למנצח) למי שהוא נאה לנַצֵּחַ to him whom it is befitting to glorify.
to conquer, prevail over. Ib. מלך ב״וד מְנַצְּחִים אותו וכ׳ a human king is angry when people defeat him (in argument; cmp. זְכֵי Pa.); Pes. l. c.—
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:5">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>נִצְּחוּנִי בני</he> (or <he>נְצָחוּנִי</he>) my children have won over me.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>תלמידי חכמים שמנצחים וכ׳</he> scholars who defeat one another in discussion.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 91a:7">Snh. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>אם יְנַּצְּחוּנִי … נַצַּחְתֶּם</he> if they defeat me, say to them, you have defeated an ignoramus among us; <he>ואם אני אֲנַצֵּחַ … תורת משה נִצְּחַתְכֶם</he> and if I defeat them, say to them, the law of Moses has defeated you; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְנוּצָּח</he>. Midr. Till. l. c. <he>למי שמנ׳ וכ׳</he> to him who allows himself to be won over by his creatures (v. supra); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be defeated. Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵇ top v. supra.
